Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang, arXiv2609.06905v1 Appendix A.1(A.1),(A.2),(A.7) and Appendix A.2. This explicit actual-history absolute-time density is attributed ASTIS completion of an implicit coordinate step; it is not a quoted standalone source theorem.
Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 define Rec=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, Hist_n=Rec^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), H_next=H_(n+1), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Let readTime(live(T,z))=T and readTime(stopped)=0; a(h)=readTime(h_n), and U(w)=readTime(H_next(w)_(n+1)). Thus U reads the actual next record, rather than being defined as a shifted waiting time. Set W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0 and t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)). Set ρ(live(T,z),s)=ofReal[λ_r(Φ_s z) exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0)))] and ρ(stopped,s)=0. The relative append A_rel(h,s) preserves every old coordinate and appends live(T+max(s,0),S_rΦ_s z) when h_n=live(T,z), and stopped when h_n=stopped. Define A_abs(h,u)=A_rel(h,u−a(h)) and L_abs(h,u)=(A_abs(h,u),u). The raw harmonic flow at negative real time, clipped cumulative increment and stopped time0 are auxiliary totalizations. H_n,H_next,a,U,A_abs,L_abs are Borel; for every abstract (h,u) and every 0≤j≤n, A_abs(h,u)_j=h_j. For any fixed Borel b:Hist_n→[0,∞), finite at every history but not required uniformly bounded, put d(h)=max(b(h)−a(h),0) and D_b(h,u)=1_{a(h)<u<b(h)}ρ(h_n,u−a(h)). Define B_rel={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))} and B={w:H_n(w)_n and H_next(w)_(n+1) are live, a(H_n(w))<U(w)<b(H_n(w))}. Let X(w)=(H_n(w),U(w)), Y(w)=(H_next(w),U(w)), and ν_b=D_b(μ_n⊗du), where du is real Lebesgue measure. D_b is jointly Borel and ∫_ℝD_b(h,u)du≤1 for EVERY abstract history h. B,X,Y are Borel and B_rel=B pointwise. For every w∈B, U(w)=a(H_n(w))+t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n) and H_next(w)=A_abs(X(w)). The exact restricted laws are X_*(P|B)=ν_b, Y_*(P|B)=(L_abs)_*ν_b and (H_next)_*(P|B)=(A_abs)_*ν_b, with ν_b(univ)≤1. For every jointly Borel G:Hist_n×ℝ→[0,∞], the parameter integral h↦∫G(h,u)D_b(h,u)du is Borel and, for every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B∩{H_n∈A}}G(X(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫G(h,u)D_b(h,u)du]μ_n(dh). For every jointly Borel F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→[0,∞], the parameter integral h↦∫F(L_abs(h,u))D_b(h,u)du is Borel and ∫_{B∩{H_n∈A}}F(Y(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫F(L_abs(h,u))D_b(h,u)du]μ_n(dh). No boundedness or integrability of F,G, positive μ_n(A), normalized conditioning, finite wait, no-atom, probability or density provider is assumed. This includes n=0, rank zero, zero hazard, stopped records, live infinite waits, b(h)≤a(h), null A and unrealizable histories; missing mass is not normalized. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one absolute-coordinate ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), not a standalone printed theorem. Finite ordered iteration, terminal survival/full path/count assembly, full(A.7), physical-time restart/Markovness, invariance, hypocoercivity, implementation/errors/unbounded query costs/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN.

{E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) :
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
    let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
        (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
    let waitObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
        | Sum.inl a => τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
    let timeObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun y xRef q => ((waitObs y xRef q).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0)
    let density : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞ :=
      fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
        | Sum.inl a => ENNReal.ofReal (rate xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 a.2) *
            Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)))
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
    ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ n : ℕ,
      let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
      let Hist := Fin (n + 1) → Rec
      let HistNext := Fin (n + 2) → Rec
      let last : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
      let lastNext : Fin (n + 2) := ⟨n + 1, Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1)⟩
      let H : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist := history y xRef z₀ n
      let Hnext : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext := history y xRef z₀ (n + 1)
      let readTime : Rec → ℝ := fun r => match r with
        | Sum.inl q => (q.1 : ℝ)
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
      let a : Hist → ℝ := fun h => readTime (h last)
      let U : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ := fun w => readTime (Hnext w lastNext)
      let appendRel : Hist × ℝ → HistNext := fun p =>
        Fin.snoc p.1 (match p.1 last with
          | Sum.inl q => Sum.inl (q.1 + Real.toNNReal p.2,
              S xRef (Φ y xRef p.2 q.2))
          | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ())
      let appendAbs : Hist × ℝ → HistNext := fun p => appendRel (p.1, p.2 - a p.1)
      let liftAbs : Hist × ℝ → HistNext × ℝ := fun p => (appendAbs p, p.2)
      Measurable H ∧ Measurable Hnext ∧ Measurable a ∧ Measurable U ∧
      Measurable appendAbs ∧ Measurable liftAbs ∧
      (∀ p : Hist × ℝ, ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), appendAbs p j.castSucc = p.1 j) ∧
      (∀ b : Hist → ℝ≥0, Measurable b →
        let d : Hist → ℝ≥0 := fun h => Real.toNNReal ((b h : ℝ) - a h)
        let μ : Measure Hist := Measure.map H P
        let D : Hist → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun h u =>
          if a h < u ∧ u < (b h : ℝ) then density y xRef (h last, u - a h) else 0
        let Brel : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
          (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) ∧
          waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) <
            ((d (H w) : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)}
        let B : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
          (∃ q, H w last = Sum.inl q) ∧
          (∃ q, Hnext w lastNext = Sum.inl q) ∧
          a (H w) < U w ∧ U w < (b (H w) : ℝ)}
        let X : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist × ℝ := fun w => (H w, U w)
        let Y : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext × ℝ := fun w => (Hnext w, U w)
        let ν : Measure (Hist × ℝ) := (μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity
          (fun p => D p.1 p.2)
        Measurable (Function.uncurry D) ∧
        (∀ h : Hist, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, D h u) ≤ 1) ∧
        MeasurableSet B ∧ Measurable X ∧ Measurable Y ∧ Brel = B ∧
        (∀ w ∈ B, U w = a (H w) +
          timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n)) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ B, Hnext w = appendAbs (X w)) ∧
        Measure.map X (P.restrict B) = ν ∧
        Measure.map Y (P.restrict B) = Measure.map liftAbs ν ∧
        Measure.map Hnext (P.restrict B) = Measure.map appendAbs ν ∧
        ν Set.univ ≤ 1 ∧
        (∀ G : Hist × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable G →
          Measurable (fun h => ∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∧
          (∀ A : Set Hist, MeasurableSet A →
            (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, G (X w) ∂P) =
              ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∂μ)) ∧
        (∀ F : HistNext × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F →
          Measurable (fun h => ∫⁻ u : ℝ, F (liftAbs (h, u)) * D h u) ∧
          (∀ A : Set Hist, MeasurableSet A →
            (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, F (Y w) ∂P) =
              ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, F (liftAbs (h, u)) * D h u) ∂μ)))

Let E be an arbitrary finite-dimensional real inner-product space, equipped with its normed additive group structure and its Borel measurable structure. Dimension zero is allowed. Let V:E→ℝ be twice continuously Fréchet differentiable. Let α,β be nonnegative real numbers and η a real number. Assume α>0, α≤β, η>0, βη≤1, and, for every x,v∈E,
  α‖v‖² ≤ (D(DV)(x)[v])[v] ≤ β‖v‖².
Here α and β in real formulas denote their real coercions. There are no other assumptions on V or on the initial/reference points.

Fix any y,xRef∈E, initial phase point z₀∈E×E, and n∈ℕ. The functions below also exist before these points and n are fixed. Write a phase point as z=(x,v). Put g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef) and c=y−η∇V(xRef). For every real t define
  Φ(t,(x,v))=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)v,
              −sin(t)/√η (x−c)+cos(t)v).
Define
  S(x,v)=(x,v−[2⟨v,g(x)⟩/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)),
  λ(x,v)=√η max(0,⟨v,g(x)⟩).
All products with vectors are real scalar multiplication. Division is total with division by zero equal to zero; in particular S(x,v)=(x,v) whenever g(x)=0. The flow Φ is defined on all real times, including negative times. For t∈ℝ≥0 define the real interval Bochner integral
  Λ(z,t)=∫₀ᵗ λ(Φ(s,z)) ds.
For e∈ℝ≥0 define the extended nonnegative waiting time
  τ(z,e)=inf{t∈ℝ≥0 : Λ(z,t)−e≥0} ∈ [0,∞],
where the infimum of the empty hitting set is ∞, with the hitting search starting at time 0. The target is the closed nonnegative half-line, so equality Λ=e is included. Write τ₀(z,e) for τ(z,e) when finite and for 0 when τ(z,e)=∞. This is the literal untopD 0 default, not a claim that an infinite wait is a zero waiting event.

The tagged record space is Rec=(ℝ≥0×(E×E)) ⊔ {†}. Denote its two distinct tags by live(a,z) and †. A live record contains cumulative time a≥0 and a phase point z. The singleton tag has no such data. For an input e≥0 define
  next(e,†)=†;
  next(e,live(a,z))=† if τ(z,e)=∞;
  next(e,live(a,z))=live(a+τ₀(z,e), S(Φ(τ₀(z,e),z))) otherwise.
For any sequence e:ℕ→ℝ≥0, the finite recursion starts at r₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and sets rₖ₊₁(e)=next(eₖ,rₖ(e)). Once † occurs it persists.

The underlying sample space is Ω=ℝ^ℕ, with P the canonical countable product of rate-one exponential probability laws on ℝ. For every w∈Ω define εₖ(w)=max(wₖ,0)∈ℝ≥0 and Rₖ(w)=rₖ(ε(w)). These definitions apply to every real sequence, not just to sequences in the almost-sure support of P. Put Hist=Rec^{0,…,n} and HistNext=Rec^{0,…,n+1}. Define H(w)=(R₀(w),…,Rₙ(w)) and Hnext(w)=(R₀(w),…,Rₙ₊₁(w)). In particular H includes the entire finite record tuple through stage n, with its tags. Products and finite function spaces carry the indicated Borel structures. Define readTime(live(a,z))=a as a real number and readTime(†)=0. For any h∈Hist define a(h)=readTime(hₙ), and for any w∈Ω define U(w)=readTime(Rₙ₊₁(w)). Thus U is the cumulative time of a live next record and is zero for a next record tagged †.

For r∈Rec and q∈ℝ define three observations. The extended wait is
  W(live(a,z),q)=τ(z,max(q,0)),  W(†,q)=0.
Its real-valued version T(r,q) is W(r,q) coerced to a real number when finite, and is zero when W(r,q)=∞. In particular T(†,q)=0. The nonnegative extended density observation is
  ρ(live(a,z),t)=ofReal( λ(Φ(t,z)) exp(−Λ(z,max(t,0))) ),
  ρ(†,t)=0,
for every real t. Here ofReal(r)=max(r,0), embedded into [0,∞]. The stored cumulative time a is ignored by W and ρ. In the formula for ρ, the flow uses the raw real t whereas the integrated rate uses max(t,0). These inputs must not be identified for negative t.

For h∈Hist and s∈ℝ define appendRel(h,s) to be the tuple h followed by
  live(q+max(s,0), S(Φ(s,z))) if hₙ=live(q,z),
  † if hₙ=†.
The flow again uses the raw real s, while the appended time uses max(s,0). Define
  appendAbs(h,u)=appendRel(h,u−a(h)),
  liftAbs(h,u)=(appendAbs(h,u),u).
These maps are defined for every h and every u∈ℝ, including h not arising from the recursion and u≤a(h). The first n+1 coordinates of appendAbs(h,u) are exactly h.

The proposition asserts that H, Hnext, a, U, appendAbs and liftAbs are Borel measurable, and that, for every (h,u)∈Hist×ℝ and every j∈{0,…,n}, the jth old coordinate of appendAbs(h,u) is hⱼ.

In addition, for EVERY Borel measurable function b:Hist→ℝ≥0, make the following definitions. This is an arbitrary cutoff depending on the whole history, not necessarily a constant, a function only of its last coordinate, or a bound beyond its current cumulative time. Let
  d(h)=max(b(h)−a(h),0)∈ℝ≥0,
  μ=H_*P.
For all h∈Hist and u∈ℝ set
  D(h,u)=ρ(hₙ,u−a(h)) if a(h)<u<b(h),
  D(h,u)=0 otherwise.
Both inequalities are strict. In particular when hₙ=live(q,z), the density on that interval is
  ofReal(λ(Φ(u−q,z)) exp(−Λ(z,max(u−q,0))));
when hₙ=† it is zero everywhere. This definition and the forthcoming fiber bound apply to every h, even histories not in the image or support of H.

Define events
  Brel={w : 0<W(Rₙ(w),wₙ)<d(H(w))},
where these comparisons take place in the extended nonnegative reals and the finite d is embedded there, and
  B={w : Rₙ(w) has the live tag, Rₙ₊₁(w) has the live tag,
           a(H(w))<U(w)<b(H(w))}.
The explicit live requirements cannot be replaced by inequalities using the zero-valued time defaults alone. Define X(w)=(H(w),U(w)), Y(w)=(Hnext(w),U(w)), and the measure ν on Hist×ℝ by
  ν=(μ⊗Lebesgue).withDensity((h,u)↦D(h,u)).
Thus ν integrates the displayed nonnegative density against the history law and ordinary real Lebesgue measure.

For each such b the proposition asserts all of the following simultaneously:
1. D is jointly Borel measurable. For EVERY h∈Hist,
     ∫_[ℝ] D(h,u) du ≤ 1,
   where this is a nonnegative extended Lebesgue integral.
2. B is measurable; X and Y are measurable; and Brel=B as exact sets, with no almost-everywhere qualification.
3. For EVERY w∈B,
     U(w)=a(H(w))+T(Rₙ(w),wₙ),
     Hnext(w)=appendAbs(X(w)).
4. The following are equalities of measures:
     X_*(P restricted to B)=ν,
     Y_*(P restricted to B)=(liftAbs)_*ν,
     (Hnext)_*(P restricted to B)=(appendAbs)_*ν.
   Also ν(Hist×ℝ)≤1. Restrictions are unnormalized. In particular the first measure identity implies ν(Hist×ℝ)=P(B); the formula is valid also when P(B)=0. It does not divide by P(B) or assert that ν is a probability measure.
5. For EVERY Borel measurable G:Hist×ℝ→[0,∞], the function
     h↦∫_[ℝ] G(h,u)D(h,u) du
   is measurable, and for EVERY Borel A⊆Hist,
     ∫_[B∩H⁻¹(A)] G(X(w)) P(dw)
       =∫_[A] [∫_[ℝ] G(h,u)D(h,u) du] μ(dh).
6. For EVERY Borel measurable F:HistNext×ℝ→[0,∞], the function
     h↦∫_[ℝ] F(liftAbs(h,u))D(h,u) du
   is measurable, and for EVERY Borel A⊆Hist,
     ∫_[B∩H⁻¹(A)] F(Y(w)) P(dw)
       =∫_[A] [∫_[ℝ] F(liftAbs(h,u))D(h,u) du] μ(dh).
   Expanding liftAbs, the test function on the right is F(appendAbs(h,u),u).

All integrals in items 1 and 5–6 and the withDensity construction take values in the extended nonnegative reals. G and F may take the value ∞ and no integrability or boundedness assumption is imposed; equality remains meaningful even when both sides are ∞. Products use extended-nonnegative arithmetic, in particular 0·∞=∞·0=0. Hence a zero density contributes zero even for an infinite test value. Null restrictions integrate every nonnegative extended test function to zero. No conditional probability on a positive-probability history event is needed: A is arbitrary measurable, and μ(A)=0 is permitted. The cutoff may satisfy b(h)≤a(h), in which case the interval at that h is empty and d(h)=0. Zero waits, infinite waits, and waits ending exactly at the upper cutoff are excluded by Brel; the assertion does not claim they are impossible for every input. The pointwise recursions and event equality include input sequences of P-measure zero, including coordinates that are negative or zero. There is no assertion of global non-explosion, eventual finiteness of each wait, normalization of each density fiber to one, stationarity, or a source-equivalence verdict. This is a statement at each finite index n with the displayed restrictions.

private def actual_absolute_next_event_time_statement

    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {V : E → ℝ} {α β : ℝ≥0} {η : ℝ}
    (hα : 0 < (α : ℝ)) (hαβ : α ≤ β) (hV : ContDiff ℝ 2 V)
    (hH : ∀ x v : E,
      (α : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ∧
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v) v ≤ (β : ℝ) * ‖v‖ ^ 2)
    (hη : 0 < η) (hβη : (β : ℝ) * η ≤ 1) : Prop :=
    let c : E → E → E := fun y xRef => y - η • gradient V xRef
    let Φ : E → E → ℝ → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun y xRef t z =>
      (c y xRef + Real.cos t • (z.1 - c y xRef) +
          (Real.sqrt η * Real.sin t) • z.2,
       (-Real.sin t / Real.sqrt η) • (z.1 - c y xRef) + Real.cos t • z.2)
    let S : E → (E × E) → (E × E) := fun xRef z =>
      (z.1, z.2 - (2 * inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef) /
        ‖gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef‖ ^ 2) • (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let rate : E → (E × E) → ℝ := fun xRef z =>
      Real.sqrt η * max 0 (inner ℝ z.2 (gradient V z.1 - gradient V xRef))
    let Λ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → ℝ := fun y xRef z t =>
      ∫ s in (0 : ℝ)..(t : ℝ), rate xRef (Φ y xRef s z)
    let τ : E → E → (E × E) → ℝ≥0 → WithTop ℝ≥0 := fun y xRef z e =>
      MeasureTheory.hittingAfter
        (fun t : ℝ≥0 => fun a : (E × E) × (E × E) × ℝ≥0 =>
          Λ a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2.1 t - (a.2.2 : ℝ))
        (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) 0 ((y, xRef), z, e)
    let next : E → E → ℝ≥0 → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef e r =>
      match r with
      | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ()
      | Sum.inl a =>
        if τ y xRef a.2 e = ⊤ then Sum.inr () else
          Sum.inl (a.1 + (τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0,
            S xRef (Φ y xRef (((τ y xRef a.2 e).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) a.2))
    let record : E → E → (E × E) → (ℕ → ℝ≥0) → ℕ →
        ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) := fun y xRef z₀ e n =>
      Nat.rec (Sum.inl (0, z₀)) (fun k r => next y xRef (e k) r) n
    let P : Measure (ℕ → ℝ) := Measure.infinitePi (fun _ : ℕ => expMeasure (1 : ℝ))
    let ε : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℕ → ℝ≥0 := fun w k => Real.toNNReal (w k)
    let history : E → E → (E × E) → (n : ℕ) → (ℕ → ℝ) →
        (Fin (n + 1) → ((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit)) :=
      fun y xRef z₀ n w j => record y xRef z₀ (ε w) j.val
    let waitObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → WithTop ℝ≥0 :=
      fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
        | Sum.inl a => τ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
    let timeObs : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun y xRef q => ((waitObs y xRef q).untopD 0 : ℝ≥0)
    let density : E → E → (((ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit) × ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞ :=
      fun y xRef q => match q.1 with
        | Sum.inl a => ENNReal.ofReal (rate xRef (Φ y xRef q.2 a.2) *
            Real.exp (-Λ y xRef a.2 (Real.toNNReal q.2)))
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
    ∀ y xRef : E, ∀ z₀ : E × E, ∀ n : ℕ,
      let Rec := (ℝ≥0 × (E × E)) ⊕ Unit
      let Hist := Fin (n + 1) → Rec
      let HistNext := Fin (n + 2) → Rec
      let last : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n⟩
      let lastNext : Fin (n + 2) := ⟨n + 1, Nat.lt_succ_self (n + 1)⟩

      let Hnext : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext := history y xRef z₀ (n + 1)
      let readTime : Rec → ℝ := fun r => match r with
        | Sum.inl q => (q.1 : ℝ)
        | Sum.inr _ => 0
      let a : Hist → ℝ := fun h => readTime (h last)
      let U : (ℕ → ℝ) → ℝ := fun w => readTime (Hnext w lastNext)
      let appendRel : Hist × ℝ → HistNext := fun p =>
        Fin.snoc p.1 (match p.1 last with
          | Sum.inl q => Sum.inl (q.1 + Real.toNNReal p.2,
              S xRef (Φ y xRef p.2 q.2))
          | Sum.inr _ => Sum.inr ())
      let appendAbs : Hist × ℝ → HistNext := fun p => appendRel (p.1, p.2 - a p.1)
      let liftAbs : Hist × ℝ → HistNext × ℝ := fun p => (appendAbs p, p.2)
      Measurable H ∧ Measurable Hnext ∧ Measurable a ∧ Measurable U ∧
      Measurable appendAbs ∧ Measurable liftAbs ∧
      (∀ p : Hist × ℝ, ∀ j : Fin (n + 1), appendAbs p j.castSucc = p.1 j) ∧
      (∀ b : Hist → ℝ≥0, Measurable b →
        let d : Hist → ℝ≥0 := fun h => Real.toNNReal ((b h : ℝ) - a h)
        let μ : Measure Hist := Measure.map H P
        let D : Hist → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun h u =>
          if a h < u ∧ u < (b h : ℝ) then density y xRef (h last, u - a h) else 0
        let Brel : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
          (0 : WithTop ℝ≥0) < waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) ∧
          waitObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n) <
            ((d (H w) : ℝ≥0) : WithTop ℝ≥0)}
        let B : Set (ℕ → ℝ) := {w |
          (∃ q, H w last = Sum.inl q) ∧
          (∃ q, Hnext w lastNext = Sum.inl q) ∧
          a (H w) < U w ∧ U w < (b (H w) : ℝ)}
        let X : (ℕ → ℝ) → Hist × ℝ := fun w => (H w, U w)
        let Y : (ℕ → ℝ) → HistNext × ℝ := fun w => (Hnext w, U w)
        let ν : Measure (Hist × ℝ) := (μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity
          (fun p => D p.1 p.2)
        Measurable (Function.uncurry D) ∧
        (∀ h : Hist, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, D h u) ≤ 1) ∧
        MeasurableSet B ∧ Measurable X ∧ Measurable Y ∧ Brel = B ∧
        (∀ w ∈ B, U w = a (H w) +
          timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n)) ∧
        (∀ w ∈ B, Hnext w = appendAbs (X w)) ∧
        Measure.map X (P.restrict B) = ν ∧
        Measure.map Y (P.restrict B) = Measure.map liftAbs ν ∧
        Measure.map Hnext (P.restrict B) = Measure.map appendAbs ν ∧
        ν Set.univ ≤ 1 ∧
        (∀ G : Hist × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable G →
          Measurable (fun h => ∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∧
          (∀ A : Set Hist, MeasurableSet A →
            (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, G (X w) ∂P) =
              ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∂μ)) ∧
        (∀ F : HistNext × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable F →
          Measurable (fun h => ∫⁻ u : ℝ, F (liftAbs (h, u)) * D h u) ∧
          (∀ A : Set Hist, MeasurableSet A →
            (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, F (Y w) ∂P) =
              ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, F (liftAbs (h, u)) * D h u) ∂μ)))

steps.title: Transfer all old-history and absolute-time tests
steps.text: Let π drop the last record from an extended history. It is Borel, π(H_next)=H_n and π(A_rel(h,s))=h. For any jointly Borel G, use G_rel(h_next,s)=G(πh_next,a(πh_next)+s) in the existing complete-history law. The actual clock identity identifies its left integrand with G(H_n,U) on B. In each right fiber, Lebesgue translation converts G(h,a+s)D_rel(h,s) to G(h,u)D_b(h,u). Integrating over any Borel A gives the unnormalized identity, including null A. Borel parameter integration follows from joint nonnegative measurability, without boundedness or integrability assumptions.

let oldPrefix : HistNext → Hist := fun h j => h j.castSucc
  have hprefixM : Measurable oldPrefix := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro j
    exact measurable_pi_apply j.castSucc
  have hprefixRel (p : Hist × ℝ) : oldPrefix (appendRel p) = p.1 := by
    funext j
    exact hprefix p j
  have hprefixActual (w : ℕ → ℝ) : oldPrefix (Hnext w) = H w := rfl
  have htranslate (G : Hist × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hG : Measurable G) (h : Hist) :
      (∫⁻ s : ℝ, G (h, a h + s) * Drel h s) =
        ∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u := by
    calc
      (∫⁻ s : ℝ, G (h, a h + s) * Drel h s) =
          ∫⁻ s : ℝ, G (h, a h + s) * D h (a h + s) :=
        lintegral_congr (fun s => by rw [hshift h s])
      _ = ∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u :=
        (measurePreserving_add_left (volume : Measure ℝ) (a h)).lintegral_comp
          ((hG.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)).mul hD.of_uncurry_left)
  have hGtests (G : Hist × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (hG : Measurable G) :
      Measurable (fun h => ∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∧
      (∀ A : Set Hist, MeasurableSet A →
        (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, G (X w) ∂P) =
          ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∂μ) := by
    let Grel : HistNext × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun q =>
      G (oldPrefix q.1, a (oldPrefix q.1) + q.2)
    have hp : Measurable (fun q : HistNext × ℝ => oldPrefix q.1) :=
      hprefixM.comp measurable_fst
    have hGrel : Measurable Grel := hG.comp (hp.prodMk ((ha.comp hp).add measurable_snd))
    have htest := h90d.2.2.2.2.2.2 Grel hGrel
    refine ⟨(hG.mul hD).lintegral_prod_right', ?_⟩
    intro A hA
    have htestA :
        (∫⁻ w in Brel ∩ H ⁻¹' A,
          Grel (Hnext w, timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n)) ∂P) =
          ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ s : ℝ, Grel (appendRel (h, s), s) * Drel h s) ∂μ :=
      htest.2 A hA
    rw [hBeq] at htestA
    calc
      (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, G (X w) ∂P) =
          ∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A,
            Grel (Hnext w, timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n)) ∂P := by
        apply setLIntegral_congr_fun (hB.inter (hA.preimage hhistory))
        intro w hw
        change G (H w, U w) =
          G (oldPrefix (Hnext w), a (oldPrefix (Hnext w)) +
            timeObs y xRef (record y xRef z₀ (ε w) n, w n))
        rw [hprefixActual, hclock w hw.1]
      _ = ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ s : ℝ, Grel (appendRel (h, s), s) * Drel h s) ∂μ := htestA
      _ = ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∂μ := by
        apply setLIntegral_congr_fun hA
        intro h _
        simpa only [Grel, hprefixRel] using htranslate G hG h

steps.title: Recover the weighted joint measure and its actual-history marginals
steps.text: Reuse only the probability-normalization component of the canonical exponential-product theorem to obtain probability P and its Borel pushforward μ_n. Apply the preceding test identity at A=univ. Equality against every Borel nonnegative test, Tonelli and the withDensity integral formula yield X_*(P|B)=D_b(μ_n⊗du). On B, Y=L_abs(X) and H_next=A_abs(X), so measurable pushforward composition gives both remaining laws. Their reference measure ν_b has total mass P(B)≤1. Missing mass is never renormalized.
steps.lean:
-- Reuse the canonical actual input probability; no new normalization premise.
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure P :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.UnitExponentialProduct.unit_exponential_product_laws.1
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map hhistory.aemeasurable
  have hmapX : Measure.map X (P.restrict B) = ν := by
    apply Measure.ext_of_lintegral
    intro G hG
    have huniv := (hGtests G hG).2 Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ
    simp only [Set.preimage_univ, Set.inter_univ, setLIntegral_univ] at huniv
    calc
      (∫⁻ p, G p ∂Measure.map X (P.restrict B)) =
          ∫⁻ w in B, G (X w) ∂P := lintegral_map hG hX
      _ = ∫⁻ h, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, G (h, u) * D h u) ∂μ := huniv
      _ = ∫⁻ p : Hist × ℝ, G p * D p.1 p.2 ∂μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
        (lintegral_prod _ (hG.mul hD).aemeasurable).symm
      _ = ∫⁻ p, G p ∂ν := by
        change _ = ∫⁻ p, G p ∂(μ.prod (volume : Measure ℝ)).withDensity (Function.uncurry D)
        exact ((lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ hD hG).trans
          (lintegral_congr fun p => mul_comm _ _)).symm
  have hYactual (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : w ∈ B) : Y w = liftAbs (X w) :=
    Prod.ext (hactual w hw) rfl
  have hmapY : Measure.map Y (P.restrict B) = Measure.map liftAbs ν := by
    rw [← hmapX, Measure.map_map hlift hX]
    exact Measure.map_congr (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hB hYactual)
  have hmarginal : Measure.map Hnext (P.restrict B) = Measure.map appendAbs ν := by
    rw [← hmapX, Measure.map_map happend hX]
    exact Measure.map_congr (ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hB hactual)
  have hmass : ν Set.univ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← hmapX, Measure.map_apply hX MeasurableSet.univ, Set.preimage_univ,
      Measure.restrict_apply MeasurableSet.univ, Set.univ_inter]
    exact prob_le_one

steps.title: Obtain every next-history test and retain the remaining boundary
steps.text: For jointly Borel F, apply the old-history test identity to G=F∘L_abs. Its parameter integral is Borel. The pointwise Y=L_abs(X) identity replaces the integrand throughout B∩{H_n∈A}, giving the displayed identity for every Borel A. This proves one strict next absolute-time step; iteration over ordered times, terminal survival, full path/count identification and full A.7 still require separate proofs.

refine ⟨hD, hfiber, hB, hX, hY, hBeq, hclock, hactual,

  intro F hF
  have htest := hGtests (F ∘ liftAbs) (hF.comp hlift)
  refine ⟨htest.1, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  calc
    (∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, F (Y w) ∂P) =
        ∫⁻ w in B ∩ H ⁻¹' A, (F ∘ liftAbs) (X w) ∂P := by
      apply setLIntegral_congr_fun (hB.inter (hA.preimage hhistory))
      intro w hw
      exact congrArg F (hYactual w hw.1)
    _ = ∫⁻ h in A, (∫⁻ u : ℝ, F (liftAbs (h, u)) * D h u) ∂μ := htest.2 A hA

lesson.lean_statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero. Let V:E→ℝ be C², α,β≥0 and η∈ℝ with α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0 and βη≤1. Fix any deterministic y,r∈E and initial phase z₀∈E×E. Put c=y−η∇V(r), Φ_t(x,p)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), g_r(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(r), S_r(x,p)=(x,p−2〈p,g_r(x)〉g_r(x)/‖g_r(x)‖²), λ_r(x,p)=√η max{0,〈p,g_r(x)〉}, Λ_z(t)=∫₀ᵗλ_r(Φ_s(z))ds and τ_z(e)=inf{t≥0:Λ_z(t)≥e}∈[0,∞], with inf empty=∞. Total real division makes S_r the identity at g_r(x)=0. The record space is D=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, with Borel sum structure. Define next(e,stopped)=stopped; for a live record (T,z), next(e,(T,z))=stopped if τ_z(e)=∞, and otherwise next(e,(T,z))=(T+τ_z(e),S_rΦ_(τ_z(e))(z)). In the Lean definition untopD0 is used only in this non-top branch. Define R₀(e)=live(0,z₀) and R_(j+1)(e)=next(e_j,R_j(e)). Let Ω=ℝ^ℕ with its product Borel structure and P=⊗_(k≥0)Exp(1). Let ε(w)_k=max{w_k,0}; this is an ambient coordinate extension on a P-null nonpositive-clock set, not new source dynamics for negative clocks. For every deterministic n≥0 define Rec=([0,∞)×(E×E))⊕{stopped}, Hist_n=Rec^(Fin(n+1)), H_n(w)=(R_j(ε(w)))_(0≤j≤n), H_next=H_(n+1), and μ_n=(H_n)_*P. Let readTime(live(T,z))=T and readTime(stopped)=0; a(h)=readTime(h_n), and U(w)=readTime(H_next(w)_(n+1)). Thus U reads the actual next record, rather than being defined as a shifted waiting time. Set W(live(T,z),e)=τ_z(max(e,0)), W(stopped,e)=0 and t(r,e)=real(untopD_0 W(r,e)). Set ρ(live(T,z),s)=ofReal[λ_r(Φ_s z) exp(−Λ_z(max(s,0)))] and ρ(stopped,s)=0. The relative append A_rel(h,s) preserves every old coordinate and appends live(T+max(s,0),S_rΦ_s z) when h_n=live(T,z), and stopped when h_n=stopped. Define A_abs(h,u)=A_rel(h,u−a(h)) and L_abs(h,u)=(A_abs(h,u),u). The raw harmonic flow at negative real time, clipped cumulative increment and stopped time0 are auxiliary totalizations. H_n,H_next,a,U,A_abs,L_abs are Borel; for every abstract (h,u) and every 0≤j≤n, A_abs(h,u)_j=h_j. For any fixed Borel b:Hist_n→[0,∞), finite at every history but not required uniformly bounded, put d(h)=max(b(h)−a(h),0) and D_b(h,u)=1_{a(h)<u<b(h)}ρ(h_n,u−a(h)). Define B_rel={w:0<W(R_n(ε(w)),w_n)<d(H_n(w))} and B={w:H_n(w)_n and H_next(w)_(n+1) are live, a(H_n(w))<U(w)<b(H_n(w))}. Let X(w)=(H_n(w),U(w)), Y(w)=(H_next(w),U(w)), and ν_b=D_b(μ_n⊗du), where du is real Lebesgue measure. D_b is jointly Borel and ∫_ℝD_b(h,u)du≤1 for EVERY abstract history h. B,X,Y are Borel and B_rel=B pointwise. For every w∈B, U(w)=a(H_n(w))+t(R_n(ε(w)),w_n) and H_next(w)=A_abs(X(w)). The exact restricted laws are X_*(P|B)=ν_b, Y_*(P|B)=(L_abs)_*ν_b and (H_next)_*(P|B)=(A_abs)_*ν_b, with ν_b(univ)≤1. For every jointly Borel G:Hist_n×ℝ→[0,∞], the parameter integral h↦∫G(h,u)D_b(h,u)du is Borel and, for every Borel A⊆Hist_n, ∫_{B∩{H_n∈A}}G(X(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫G(h,u)D_b(h,u)du]μ_n(dh). For every jointly Borel F:Hist_(n+1)×ℝ→[0,∞], the parameter integral h↦∫F(L_abs(h,u))D_b(h,u)du is Borel and ∫_{B∩{H_n∈A}}F(Y(w))P(dw)=∫_A[∫F(L_abs(h,u))D_b(h,u)du]μ_n(dh). No boundedness or integrability of F,G, positive μ_n(A), normalized conditioning, finite wait, no-atom, probability or density provider is assumed. This includes n=0, rank zero, zero hazard, stopped records, live infinite waits, b(h)≤a(h), null A and unrealizable histories; missing mass is not normalized. This is attributed ASTIS completion of one absolute-coordinate ingredient implicit in Appendix A.1(A.7), not a standalone printed theorem. Finite ordered iteration, terminal survival/full path/count assembly, full(A.7), physical-time restart/Markovness, invariance, hypocoercivity, implementation/errors/unbounded query costs/main/composition/wholepaper/Goal remain OPEN.
